note: Easy Responsive Images generates image styles named responsive_<width>w (scale), responsive_<w>_<h>_<width>w (aspect crop) and responsive_<height>h (fixed height) from a settings form at /admin/config/media/image-styles/generate (config easy_responsive_images.settings; only shipped default is lazy_loading_threshold=1250). Output via the easy_responsive_images field formatter (image fields) or the image_url Twig filter. Medium cases read back known config (maximum_width=1600) and generated styles (responsive_320w/640w). Hard cases (1) generate responsive_300w/600w/900w scale styles (image_scale effect at matching width) and (2) switch an image field's view-display formatter to easy_responsive_images. Fixtures are namespaced (field_erim_img); the responsive_* style names are the module's own fixed naming and are removed by reset/cleanup by exact name.

evals.prompt: Using the easy_responsive_images module, how do I generate a set of responsive image styles, and what are the generated image styles named?
evals.expected_output: Go to /admin/config/media/image-styles/generate, enter a min/max width, a step and optional aspect ratios, and save. It creates styles named responsive_<width>w (scale), responsive_<w>_<h>_<width>w (aspect-ratio crop) and responsive_<height>h.

evals.prompt: In a custom Twig template, how do I build a URL to one of the responsive image styles created by easy_responsive_images from a file URI?
evals.expected_output: Use the image_url Twig filter: {{ file.uri.value|image_url('responsive_16_9_550w') }}. It returns the derivative URL (WebP/Avif when those modules are installed).

evals.prompt: Which field formatter does easy_responsive_images provide for image fields, and what are its main display options?
evals.expected_output: The 'Easy Responsive Images' formatter (id easy_responsive_images) for image fields, with options image_handling (scale or aspect_ratio), aspect_ratio, multiplier (1x-4x) and cover. It emits a data-srcset and the resizer JS loads the best derivative.

evals.prompt: On this site, easy_responsive_images has been configured with a specific width range for style generation. Inspect the live configuration and state the maximum image width it is set to generate up to.
evals.expected_output: maximum_width = 1600 in easy_responsive_images.settings (min 400, step 400, aspect ratios 16:9).

evals.prompt: Which responsive image styles generated by easy_responsive_images currently exist on this site? Inspect the live image styles and name them.
evals.expected_output: responsive_320w and responsive_640w (scale styles with an image_scale effect).

evals.prompt: Using easy_responsive_images, generate responsive scale image styles for widths from 300 to 900 pixels in steps of 300 (i.e. 300, 600 and 900), applying the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Image styles responsive_300w, responsive_600w and responsive_900w exist, each with an image_scale effect at width 300/600/900 (e.g. set minimum_width=300, maximum_width=900, threshold_width=300 and generate, or create the styles directly).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an image field field_erim_img. Configure its default display so the image is output responsively using the easy_responsive_images field formatter, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_erim_img component uses type 'easy_responsive_images' (set via Manage display or the entity_view_display component).
